purpose: D-018 pre-result model-seed registry for a new, unused, non-sealed Phase D confirmatory cohort (REVERSE short-sequence-repair causal transfer pilot). This is a static provenance record, not an execution configuration. It reuses D-005's exact audit methodology and source/historical registrations unchanged, and adds exactly one new historical entry: the Phase D five-model cohort (seeds 40-44) and its registered evaluation seeds (301-305), which D-017's evidence-integrity audit restricts to exploratory-only use for any next charter. This document accordingly treats seeds 40-44 and eval seeds 301-305 as forbidden/used for the purpose of fixing a genuinely new confirmatory cohort, and fixes five new seeds never used by any prior registration.

candidate_cohort.replacement_policy: No member may be excluded, added, or exchanged after any cohort-build, training, or evaluation result. A collision or unavailable artifact is a STOP condition requiring a new ADR; it does not permit a substitute seed.

source_seed_registrations.role: sealed_model_seed; permanently forbidden to Phase D

data_lineage.cohort_build: The exact D-001/D-005 Model Bundle Recovery stage graph (PHASE_D_FIVE_MODEL_COHORT_CONSTRUCTION_CONTRACT.md section 3), run as a fresh build for these new seeds. No data from any Phase B validation or sealed partition, and no data from the D-013 seed-40-44 cohort, is an input to this cohort.
data_lineage.repair_and_registered_evaluations: d001_train:<model_seed>:<step>:<op>-style deterministic derivation (_derive_local_seed), unchanged mechanism, applied to REVERSE instead of SORT and to a new length-sampling bound per condition (PHASE_D_D018_REVERSE_SHORT_SEQUENCE_REPAIR_PILOT_PREREGISTRATION.md section 4). New evaluation seeds 401-405 are fixed separately in that document (not model seeds; not checked by this JSON's schema, verified manually against every range above plus 301-305).
